Self-awareness.text: I have a very good understanding of why I do the things I do
I am often confused about my feelings

Social awareness.text: I can tell how people are feeling by listening to the tone of their voice
It is difficult for me to understand why people feel the way they do

Situational awareness.text: Right now, I am conscious of all objects around me.
Right now, I am keenly aware of everything in my environment.

Clarity of purpose.text: I have a clear idea of how projects will be completed.

Strategic foresight.text: What percentage of your current objectives stretch on for more than two years into the future?
Most of my objectives are focused on achieving targets due in the next six months .

Balanced processing.text: I am very uncomfortable objectively considering my limitations and shortcomings
I often find that I am overly critical about myself.
I often deny the validity of any compliments that I receive.

Self-compassion.text: I regularly remind myself that failure and challenges are part of the human experience.
In the past seven days I engaged in supportive and comforting self-talk

Tolerance for ambiguity.text: I like to surround myself with things that are familiar to me
I like parties where I know most of the people more than ones where all or most of the people are complete strangers
A good job is one where what is to be done and how it is to be done are always clear

Tolerance for complexity.text: If I were a scientist, it would bother me that my work would never be completed (because they always make new discoveries)
A good manager won’t make a decision until they have every possible piece of information about a matter .
It is frightening just how messy the world is .
Being unable to predict the future is exciting.

Capacity for informal influence.text: I don’t need a position or title to inspire others
I inspire others to want to achieve their goals
Having a leadership position is the easiest way to influence others

Capacity for collaboration.text: I am open and honest with those around me
I seek opportunities to meet with colleagues who disagree with me
Managers need to focus on objectives more than team members

Capacity to establish networks.text: I introduce myself to the person next to me while waiting in line.
I tend to avoid eye contact while waiting near other people
I will actively seek deep conversation with new people at a social event.

Creative decision-making.text: I enjoy the opportunity to create new things
When I need to make a decision, I usually deploy an existing model first .
I prioritise thinking outside the box over tried-and-tested solutions.
I frequently imagine new ways of doing and being
It is easy to hold multiple possible futures at the same time.

Capacity to foster belonging.text: I actively attempt to enable two very different friends of mine to build relationships.
When I see two people conflicting at work, I take steps to help them resolve it.
At work, I focus on my work rather than building quality relationships with colleagues .

Capacity to foster intrinsic motivation.text: People around me are primarily working for money or promotions .
If I were interviewing a new staff member, I would emphasize how satisfying the work can be over wages.
I explain the benefit of a task prior to asking someone to do it.

Place-attachment.text: Tasmania will always be my home, even if I move away.
I have limited attachment to the city I live in
I consider the impact my decisions will have on my community.

Extra-role behaviours.text: I take care not to interrupt colleagues even if I need information from them.
I volunteer to help my workplace with tasks that need doing that might be out of my general scope.
At work, I prioritise on finishing only my own tasks
